about: The map POI layer's min-zoom and cluster rules (docs/architecture/everon-map.md section 1, Rendering), in the loader format of tools/map/rules/index.mjs: cases = [{ name, input, expect }]. Run by LF_Test_MapPlacesLayout (Enforce, LF_MapClusterRules.Evaluate) and tools/validation/map-cluster-selftest.mjs (node, evaluate() of tools/map/rules/cluster.mjs): one table, so the two cannot drift. Zoom: the view is 12800 m / 2^zoom wide (zoom 0 is the island, the emulator's --zoom). input: op minzoom|mode|cluster; zoom; minZoom (op minzoom); points (op cluster): comma list of id:x:z:minZoom in place order. Below zoom 4 the layer buckets the shown points into a grid whose cell is one eighth of the view width; a cell of two or more is one cluster stamp, a cell of one stays a single icon. At zoom 4 and closer every point is a single icon. A point whose kind min zoom is above the view zoom is dropped before the buckets. expect: show|hide (minzoom), solo|clustered (mode), or the comma list of what is drawn in first-member order (cluster): a single id, or a cluster as its member ids joined with +.

cases.name: a kind shows at exactly its min zoom
a kind hides below its min zoom
min zoom 0 shows at the island view
a closer zoom shows a kind with a higher min zoom
just under the solo zoom still clusters
the solo zoom draws every point alone
two points in one cell are one cluster, a far one stays single
the same points at the solo zoom are three singles
three points in a cell keep place order inside the stamp
a point below its min zoom is dropped and leaves a single
every point dropped by min zoom draws nothing
a point beside a cell edge is its own cell
the island view merges a whole town
a cluster at a closer zoom splits back to the singles
